name: influxdb
title: InfluxDB
description: Interact with InfluxDB v1, a time series database.
label: database

properties.name: connectionBean
properties.description: Connection to the influx database, of class InfluxDB.class

properties.name: autoCreateDatabase
properties.description: Define if we want to auto create the database if it's not present

properties.name: batch
properties.description: Define if this operation is a batch operation or not

properties.name: checkDatabaseExistence
properties.description: Define if we want to check the database existence while starting the endpoint

properties.name: databaseName
properties.description: The name of the database where the time series will be stored

properties.name: operation
properties.description: Define if this operation is an insert or a query

properties.name: query
properties.description: Define the query in case of operation query

properties.name: retentionPolicy
properties.description: The string that defines the retention policy to the data created by the endpoint

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.
